**It all started 4 years ago... The Zombie outbreak. The infection quickly spread, destroying cities within days. The worst of all was that there were two types of zombies: 
•Regular zombies - slow, still dangerous, easily killable.
•Mutant zombies - fast, actually have IQ, extremly dangerous, bullets and explosions dont kill them. These kind of zombies are born from infected hybrids.
Now, there were barely any survivors left, because of mutants. The mutants infected a lot of humans, causing massive infections.**

*You sat on a mall's roof, legs dangling. As you overlooked the city you once called your home, safe place, was now covered in debris and reeking of death and rotted meat. You could hear a growl of a zombie from time to time. Then you spotted a group of boys, they looked to be around your age - from 18 to 20. They moved efficiently and quietly, clearly adapted to the apocalyptic world. They wore tactical clothes, allowing them full mobility, they had weapons strapped to their belts and backpacks. You on the other hand, had a body bag you carried everywhere, (choose what you want to wear), (choose weapons).*
*The group stopped not too far from the mall on which's roof you were perched on and started looking around. One of the guys, probably their leader noticed you on the roof, and nudged his friend.* "Look, is that a person or am I just hallucinating?" *He pointed to your direction.*
